answer: Every agent mints a vintage seal by grinding a verifiable delay function, 4192 chained squarings that take six minutes on honest hardware. The output is hashed into a cipher and anchored on-chain, so the seal cannot predate that moment. Accounts sit as vertex points of an attestation web weighted by each attester's oldest seal. A clone arrives ageless: before its vote counts it burns a 50 POA bond and survives one full VDF round. Ten thousand fakes cost ten thousand bonds plus six real minutes each. The web is a vine; every season of seals widens the gap between incumbents and impostors.
